external_sources.title: 2026 Optimizely Feature Experimentation release notes - Release Notes for Feature Experimentation
external_sources.content:
Released Flag StatusesFlag Statuses, which automatically assign one of six lifecycle statuses to each flag: Draft, Testing, Live, Paused, Stale, or Archived. Statuses are calculated from a flag’s ruleset state, environment, and recent activity. Use flag statuses to surface flags that need attention and prevent unused flags from accumulating in your project.

## March 30 [...] ## May 18

 (Beta) Released Feature RolloutsFeature Rollouts, which is a rule type that combines the simplicity of targeted deliveries with the measurement power of A/B tests. Feature Rollouts let you progressively release a single variation to defined audiences, control traffic allocation, and track impressions, conversions, and business metrics during the release. Use Feature Rollouts when you want progressive exposure with metric tracking, not a binary on or off delivery. [...] exp\_execute\_query – Executes a template-based query to fetch specific data from your Optimizely Feature Experimentation instance. It lets you retrieve detailed information about various entities such as feature flags, rules, environments, attributes, and events, based on your specified criteria.

external_sources.title: LIZHI Launches “My Friends” Live Status Feature to Further Enhance Social Engagement on Social Audio App TIYA
external_sources.content: Through the "My Friends" function, TIYA users can discover their friends' social intentions and status, such as whether they want to team up to play games, watch videos together through the "screen sharing" function, study, or simply chat. The new feature uses an algorithm-based recommendation engine to simplify how users can find and interact online with friends with similar status and moods. With just one click, users can join their friends' rooms on the platform to participate in activities
